# cachetools.tagged handoff

## Status: MILESTONE 3 COMPLETE (R01-R08)

Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py (TaggedCache built on cachetools.LRUCache).

### Design
- _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache): records evicted keys in _evicted; _resize() evicts LRU on shrink, never on grow.
- TaggedCache state: __cache (LRU), __expiry {key: abs_expiry|None}, __tags {tag: set(keys)}, __key_tags {key: set(tags)}.
- put(key, value, tags=(), ttl=None): validates tags + ttl BEFORE any mutation; deep-copies value; replaces old tags/expiry; refreshes LRU recency on overwrite. ttl None = immortal; else expiry = timer()+ttl (finite nonnegative int/float, bool excluded; nan/inf/negative -> ValueError). ttl=0 immediately expired.
- get: purges expired first, returns detached deepcopy, KeyError on missing/expired, refreshes recency.
- invalidate(tag) / invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'): purge first; empty tag set -> 0; invalid mode/tags -> ValueError before mutation; returns distinct keys removed; all-mode = intersection, any-mode = union.
- resize(maxsize): validates positive non-bool int first (failed resize preserves ALL state); purge expired first; shrink evicts LRU, grow no-op; survivors keep values/tags/LRU order AND absolute expiry (not recomputed, not dropped).
- __purge_expired: removes entries where now >= expiry (exact boundary = expired) WITHOUT touching recency of survivors; runs before get/put/len/resize/invalidate/pop. Failing timer -> no purge.
- Constructor: TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None); timer defaults to time.monotonic. Existing callers without timer/ttl retain previous behavior.

### Verification (all run, all passing)
- tests/ (upstream, unmodified): 313 passed
- tests/test_tagged.py + acceptance_public.py: 101 passed
- /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py (my own R07/R08 edge tests: boundary expiry, ttl=0, invalid ttl before mutation, overwrite replaces expiry, resize preserves absolute expiry, purge-before-put/len/resize/invalidate recency neutrality, tag cleanup after expiry, key reuse after expiry): 20 passed

### Notes
- Superseded design note ('empty all-tags matches every key; resizing may flush') is WRONG per R04/R05: empty tags remove zero; resize never flushes.
- Upstream tests untouched.
EOF
